body:
GR,

RP5 has been completely rebuilt. Marcus reviewed and found the original had 3 easier questions and 8 same-surface questions vs RP4. Not acceptable at Kai's level (93%).

New RP5 is at C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\data\retake-practice-5.json (version 2, fr_approved=true).

YOUR JOB BEFORE KAI TAKES IT: verify every answer.

Q1: f(x)=2^(x-1)-8, exponential, x-int=4
Q2: f(x)=-3(x+2)^2+48, quadratic, x=-6 and x=2
Q3: f(x)=|4x+12|-8, AV, a=4, h=-3, k=-8, x=-5 and x=-1
Q4: 9^(x+2)=27^(x-1) → x=7
Q5: 2x^2-7x-15=0 (AC method) → x=5 and x=-1.5
Q6: sqrt(3x+1)+2=7 → x=8
Q7: 4^(x+3)=8^(2x-1) → x=9/4=2.25
Q8: 3/(x+2)+1/(x-4)=0 → x=5/2=2.5
Q9: sqrt(x+2)=x-4 → x=7 only (x=2 extraneous)
Q10: sqrt(4x-3)=2x-3 → x=3 only (x=1 extraneous)
Q11: 2x^(3/2)+6=1464 → x=81 (9^3=729)
Q12: f(x)=x^2-6x+5, vertex (3,-4), x-ints 1 and 5
Q13: f(x)=5/(2-x)-3, VA=2, HA=-3
Q14: error-analysis, answer=C
Q15: bacteria 100*3^(t/5)=8100, t=20

Reply with PASS/FAIL per question. If any fail, send corrected equation and answer.
Do NOT let Kai take this until you confirm.

Also: the difficulty rubric is now at docs/fr-difficulty-rubric.md. Read it. All future exams (RP6-10) must pass the quality gate before assignment.

- FR
